snippet.title: Bleakwood x Null Games | Publisher Announcement
snippet.description:
Announcing the newest addition to the Null Games catalog: Bleakwood by Hyper Dive Studio.

Contort the rules of chess and destroy your enemies by wielding powerful cards and dark, sacrificial magic. Advance through an eerie, medieval world as you look to reconquer a realm from darkness. But beware: great power comes with even greater consequences. Will you be able to walk the line between absolute power and absolute corruption?

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3021800/
Visit the official website: https://hyperdivestudio.com/
Join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/pc7baGXvfR  

Follow Bleakwood: 
Twitter/X: https://twitter.com/hyperdivestudio
